artifacts.summary: Re-derived all three sweeps at HEAD: 53 READMEs need stamps (CI's two-root invocation), 21 archive links need depth correction (all targets verified on disk), and the typst half is not a path rewrite -- 5 of 9 citations are orphaned and a straight re-point leaves CI red because /training/ is gitignored; a clean-checkout run also exposed a 10th violation (lakefile.lean).

user_decision.question: Four footnotes in typst/chapters/p4-dataset-pipeline.typ cite PIPELINE.md content that was deliberately deleted from that file and consolidated into the citing chapter itself, so no re-point can make them true. How should they be resolved?
options: A -- De-cite the four orphaned footnotes (state the sentences in the chapter's own voice) and whitelist the surviving training/PIPELINE.md spans plus lakefile.lean
B -- Un-ignore /training/ and git add -f it, then re-point all nine citations
C -- Whitelist all nine spans unchanged and edit no chapter prose
user_decision.recommended: A -- De-cite the four orphaned footnotes (state the sentences in the chapter's own voice) and whitelist the surviving training/PIPELINE.md spans plus lakefile.lean
